answer: Written in a economic framing, incentive alignment focus register, it stays short. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. Work waits on the spiral until a stranger signs it off, and that signature becomes the island of the next round. By the umber of the epoch the only identities still standing are the ones whose work held up. The design leans on optimistic execution with fraud proof windows.
